programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Undertaker Patrick Pennyman is found dead in the village of Fletcher's Cross, in his own chapel of rest, by his wife. Barnaby and Scott start looking into a spiritualist church in the village that had been heavily controversial. Elizabeth, a friend of Joyce, who had attended their meetings, tells her that she was suspicious of both the spiritualist church and the undertaker and believed they were acquiring information and stealing from the dead.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Down at the Midsomer Regatta, the day is interrupted by the body of Guy Sweetman, Chairman of the local rowing club, resurfacing midway through a race. Barnaby and Scott learn that Guy was a ladies' man with many past conquests. He had been in secret meetings with a few other members. The two detectives uncover lies, blackmail, jealousy and a planned robbery, before the latest woman Guy was planning to marry is attacked and almost killed.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: When a local handyman finds a female classics teacher and a member of a group of orchid enthusiasts poisoned in her own home, DCI Barnaby finds himself heading back to Midsomer Malham, the day after he and Joyce had helped out during the village's annual garden show. It is discovered that the victim had a secret lover and had helped to smuggle a rare one-of-a-kind orchid, the Yellow Roth, out of Borneo.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: A successful day at the races for the racehorse, Bantling Boy, the previous day, it is not long before one of the horses' owners is found murdered in the horses' stables. The victim, Bruce Hartley, had been in dispute with the other owners of Bantling Boy, the night before his murder had had a rather heated argument with them and had refused to let them acceptance of an offer to buy the horse. It seems to make things a whole lot worse of the others in the syndicate.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: John Ransom gets thrown out of the village pub in Midsomer Mere, for fighting with his brother-in-law, and a short while later he is found dead on the green. It is discovered that John had been used as a guinea pig for scientific experiments by his brother Max, who suspected he had the ability of 'Second Sight'. Barnaby and Scott soon discover that another family possesses the same talent. They have to delve deeper to unravel many secrets within the village to find the truth.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: When solicitor Nick Turner apparently commits suicide by walking off the roof of his home in Midsomer Magna, then Nick's neighbour Jack Wilmot mysteriously disappears that same day, it starts a series of unexplained events. Barnaby and Scott soon discover that a large amount of money has gone missing from the account of one of Nick's clients. Shortly afterwards, Nick's rival gets murdered in an elaborate ritual, by his own model of a medieval catapult, while his wife is forced to watch.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: The body of a visitor is found on-site at the famous relish factory of Plummer & Son in the village of Little Upton. When the detectives begin investigating the Plummer family and its staff, it turns out that the victim, Dexter Lockwood, was known to the family and had been on a guided tour of the factory the day before his body was found. It is not long before legal documents, family resentments and mysterious sightings add to the complexity of the case.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Retired music teacher Arthur Leggott is murdered after disturbing an intruder at his home in Badger's Drift. It is discovered that a musical manuscript by the late composer Joan Alder has since gone missing before being sent to auction. When the manuscript shows signs that it has been written by another hand, a handwritten letter by Joan Alder turns up indicating the manuscript is a forgery. Where the manuscript goes more murders follow.

programme.title: Super Sleuths - Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: This special documentary examines Inspector Barnaby - his methods and techniques of investigation, from his time in the original novels through his translation to television.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: The villagers of Fletcher's Cross are preparing for their team match against Midsomer Worthy. Tara Cavendish, the second wife of local landowner and cricket captain Robert Cavendish, has since gone missing after taking their dog for a walk. When her body is later discovered nearby in a disused quarry, with the weapon, a cricket bat lying, next to her.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Alice Bly arrives at Lawnside, a nursing home in Aspern Tallow to rest after having hospital treatment. She soon suspects something is not right when a fellow resident dies the night after her arrival. It is also discovered that the lady's valuable Cartier watch has also gone missing. Alice's nephew DCI Barnaby agrees to look into things despite having a week's leave. It is not long before two more deaths quickly follow the first and a mysterious visitor is seen lurking around at night.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: The residents of Midsomer Mallow are preparing for the 'Perfect English Village' competition even though a few days earlier saw the murder of local thief and lothario, Peter Drinkwater (Orlando Bloom). Barnaby and Troy discover that he had been stabbed with a pitchfork while squatting at an abandoned farm. The detectives must deduce if one of his burglary victims, his accomplice in the robberies or another disgruntled villager may have been the killer.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Shortly before his retirement, Superintendent Pringle arrests a local poacher for the murder of a tramp during a fox hunt in woodland close to the village of Upper Marshwood. DCI Barnaby is unsure that the poacher was the killer. Upon returning from holidaying in France, Barnaby is proved right, when the poacher's father is murdered with his own shotgun. As they reopen the investigation, they find many hidden secrets amongst the villagers.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: When the body of a local beauty is discovered by the pool at her manor house, Barnaby and Troy uncover a seedy world of adultery and deceit within the affluent rural community.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Someone is killing off parish church bell ringers in the week before a big bell-ringing competition takes place in the village of Midsomer Mallow.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Barnaby investigates the murder of a boy during a traditional annual race at an exclusive private school but meets with resentment.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: An investigation of a car fire and a bludgeon murder lead Barnaby and Troy to investigate the members of a local reading club which has an agenda that goes beyond books.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: A woman is found dead in Setwale Wood, an apparent suicide, except that her suicide note is emailed after her body has already been sighted.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Peter and Caroline Cave are house-hunting in Midsomer Newton, when they hear about a house called Winyard; a tumbledown cottage in the woods. At the estate agents they get informed "that the house is not yet available for viewing". They view the house a short time later by themselves anyway. The following morning they are both found dead in their car, near the house. DCI Barnaby and Acting DC Ben Jones enter a world of property developers, eccentric villagers, estate agents and ghost stories.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: In the village of Midsomer Barton, the villagers are all celebrating the annual Oak Apple Week. After the body of a woman is found in a stream, the return of the carnival queen event, after a hiatus of eight years, is speculated to be the reason for a series of murders. With recognisable faces from the past, drunken boasts, hidden obsessions and secret loves, Barnaby and Jones try to restore peace and harmony to the village.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: The wealthy, eccentric and obese Sir Freddy Butler drops dead, shortly after gathering all three of his wives to Haddington Hall to make an announcement. George Bullard tells Barnaby that the death was from natural causes. The case gets more complex when Freddy's solicitor is deliberately killed in an arson attack on his home and Freddy's will goes missing.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: In the village of Midsomer Worthy, council clerk Martin Barrett is shot to death through his kitchen window, while a mystery woman settles in, in the spare room upstairs. Barnaby and Jones discover Barrett was a skillful blackmailer, and believe his murderer to be one of his victims. The investigation takes Barnaby and Joyce to the seaside at Fennacombe Bay and Jones to question Sir John Waverley.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: A 90-year-old feud between the male and female inhabitants of Broughton once again comes to a head with an event known as the Skimmington Ride. When elderly Ms Danvers is poisoned a short time before the event takes place. Barnaby and Jones have to investigate whether it was to do with the feud, a long held buried secret, or something else. This looks more likely when the Rev. Anthony Gant is shot and killed whilst taking part in the traditional ride. Before another villager ends up dead.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Villagers of Eleverton-cum-Latterly are divided over the building of a new supermarket development. Shortly after a heated meeting, Frank Hopkirk, an independent environmental supervisor is found stabbed at Jubb's timber yard, the site of the new supermarket, by a pair of children. When Barnaby and Jones investigate they find he came to the village for secret rendezvous with various female villagers in fantasy role-playing scenarios.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Midsomer Worthy is gearing up for the Four Choirs Competition, when one of their members, Connor Simpson, is found dead at his home. Barnaby and Jones begin to look into the events leading to his death. The case is further complicated, when a birdwatcher and estate keeper is also killed. After it is found he had been photographing suspicious activity, an attempted murder is interrupted.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Around a year ago, Annie Woodrow was arrested and accused of the murder of her best friend, Frances Trevelyan, on the motive of fondness for Frances's husband. As Annie's trial begins, DCI Barnaby is uncertain of her guilt. A chance remark by Frances's youngest daughter and meeting with an old friend in psychiatry, makes him reevaluate the evidence for her conviction.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Deep in Blacktrees Forest is a bombproof shelter, at which a doomsday prepper group meets weekly.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Barnaby is called in when a new arrival to a tight-knit community for retired police officers is found dead.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: A trendy organic bakery in a restored mill is at the centre of a local dispute which leads to a death.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: A Parish chairwoman is found dead in a local theatre, possibly because of her hostility toward a drag show.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Badger's Drift is again at the centre of attention when local property developer Richard Bayly is found murdered in his own home. Richard had recently been diagnosed with a brain tumour. The murder weapon, an Indian sword, is found close by and is discovered to have been stolen in a burglary at the vicarage. Barnaby and Troy set out to discover who would want to kill a dying man.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Nine years before, a series of women was strangled with a neck-tie and left naked in woodland on the edge of Midsomer Worthy. When a Brazilian woman who had recently arrived in the village is also found murdered in the same way within the woods, Barnaby comes up against a retired detective who couldn't solve the previous case, a tobacco company, family arguments and problematic evidence, before other bodies turn up in the village.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: A slashed portrait of Jonathan Lowrie in the museum at Aspern Tallow brings Barnaby and Troy to investigate. They find themselves stepping back in time, dealing with a series of ghostly events, the death of elderly Marcus Lowriewho was found in the tomb of his ancestor, a mysterious escaped criminal, a therapist who isn't quite what she seems and a museum trustee with a hidden past. It is not long before the bodies start piling up and things begin to make sense.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Shortly after two groups of travellers arrive in the village of Martyr Warren, local magistrate Hector Bridges is killed with his own shotgun. Barnaby and Troy had to dissuade him from forcefully evicting the travellers with help from his army friends and learn Hector was a bully and disliked by many who knew him. The detectives have to unravel a tangle of relationships before they track down the culprit.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: In the village of Malham Bridge, eccentric widow Isobel Hewitt and adulterous doctor Duncan Goff are both murdered while fly fishing near the riverbank. DCI Barnaby and DS Troy question if one or the other was the target and whether one just happened to stumble across the other. Many suspects and motives abound, as the detectives try to find out. When another murder takes place, Barnaby deduces that it may have been a distraction to conceal the killer's identity.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: The body of Martin Wroath is found in his home in Midsomer Worthy. From first appearances it looks as though he had committed suicide by shotgun. Evidence soon suggests that he was murdered. When a second murder takes place on the grounds of the cottage hospital, the detectives need to uncover any possible connections to link the deaths, as well as the mysteriously disappearing rope.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Joyce joins the local watercolour society for an open-air art class, upon the village green in Midsomer Florey. When Barnaby is taken off the case by the NIS, it is left to Troy to 'apprehensively' let Barnaby in on what's going on with the investigation.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: At the family home of actor Larry Smith in the village of Upper Warden, a crowd has gathered to watch the promotion for the sequel to his hit film 'The House of Satan', when Larry walks into a summerhouse house in the grounds, it suddenly explodes. programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: In the village of Midsomer Magna, the body of a man is found who had apparently drowned himself. programme.desc: A scientist -- who is also a religious zealot (David Ogden Stiers) -- secretly implants an embryo created with DNA from the Shroud of Turin into a young woman (Samantha Mathis) in order to scientifically engineer the Second Coming of Christ.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: The Outer Limits come to Victorian Whitechapel when a London doctor (Cary Elwes) races to capture the alien creature responsible for the Jack the Ripper murders. But when the alien frames the good doctor for the murders, his time may be up.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: The son (Saul Rubinek) of a concentration camp survivor (Peter Boretski) gets some unique help in proving the guilt of a former Nazi (Jan Rubes) living in the U.S....courtesy of a time traveler (Alex Daikun) and, of course, The Outer Limits.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: The planets Earth and Dregocia struggle to re-establish a fragile trust after a summit goes tragically wrong. Can a diplomat (Marcia Cross) calm the hawkish nature of both species…and can she overcome her own prejudices to save both worlds?

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A meek anthropologist (Leland Orser) develops a serum for genetic dominance and tests it on himself. Now his newfound confidence takes complete control of him, turning him into an irrational, overly aggressive troglodyte! Can he reverse the process?

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: The Haven is a high-tech apartment building which is run by supercomputer and almost completely eliminates the need for human contact. But when things begin to go wrong, neighbors who have never met must learn to work together in order to survive!

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: When a scientist's (Kevin Nealon) experiment unintentionally creates a rift in the space-time continuum, he suddenly find himself caught in a time loop and soon begins to suspects sabotage. Terri Hawkes, Jennifer Copping and Ronny Cox also star.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A boy (Adam Hann-Byrd) , picked on by high-school bullies and neglected by his own father (Daniel Hugh Kelley), finds comfort in an alien (Chris Potter) who has crash-landed on earth. But is the alien what he claims to be? Never…in The Outer Limits.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: In a world dominated by alien invaders, a cynical American cafe owner (Nathan Fillion) must decide if he will risk his life to help an old lover fight for Earth or if he is happy not rocking the political boat. Derek de Lint also stars.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: When Detective Terry Russo (Megan Gallagher) is called to investigate a double murder, she discovers she may be solving not one crime, but possibly hundreds. And that the culprit -- or culprits -- may not be human at all. Michael Riley also stars.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A convicted murderer is turned loose only to be hunted by the sister of his victim as part the hottest show on television, Judgment Day, which allows the family members -- and the at home audience -- to act as judge, jury and executioner!

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: An ex-con who had been serving time for spousal abuse is bent on revenge against his wife. He purchases a strange handgun from a gun dealer and finds this is no ordinary weapon and, in fact, he becomes quite attached to it…literally.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A device that allows people to change their appearance helps a nerdy guy become the mirror image of his hunky co-worker.. Now arrogant with his new-found good looks, the former nerd experiences a life like never before…and now he wants to keep it.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: An invisible alien race that inhabits the energy systems of a deserted spaceship envelopes the crew of a salvage team, responding to the empty vessel's distress signal, in a web of paranoia, suspicion and murder. Michael Shanks stars.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: When a scientist uses his time machine to travel into the future, he discovers his wife lying dead in a pool of blood and a man fleeing the scene. Determined save her, he uses the time machine to go back in time...but is her death inevitable?

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A blind man (Mackenzie Astin) regains his sight only to be used by the government for his unique ability to see an alien from another dimension who has been trapped on Earth and yearns to return home. But the government has other plans for her.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A veterinarian (Jessica Tuck) in a small farming community becomes alarmed when a genetically-engineered corn seed, intended to produce faster, larger yields of corn, produces something far more alarming …human mutations! Len Cariou also stars.

programme.title: State Of Grace
programme.desc: An undercover cop (Sean Penn) comes back to his old neighborhood in Hell's Kitchen to bring down the Irish Mafia.

programme.title: Kalifornia
programme.desc: A couple (David Duchovny, Michelle Forbes) sets out on a cross-country trip to research a book about serial killers and, along the way, pick up an ex-con and his girlfriend (Brad Pitt, Juliette Lewis) who take them on a ride they'll never forget.

programme.title: Anti-Trust
programme.desc: In this sizzling, fast-paced thriller, computer whiz Milo Hoffman (Ryan Phillippe) lands his dream job at a major computer company, only to learn that the C.E.O. (Tim Robbins) may employ some very unorthodox -- and very deadly --business practices.

programme.title: Into the Blue
programme.desc: Paul Walker and Jessica Alba heat up the screen as two divers who dream of finding hidden treasure.

programme.title: Bandits
programme.desc: Strap yourself in for one hilarious action-comedy starring Bruce Willis, Billy Bob Thornton and Cate Blanchett! Convicts Joe (Willis) and Terry (Thornton) run an ingenious bank robbery scheme...until they meet an eccentric housewife (Blanchett).

programme.title: Mulholland Falls
programme.desc: In the 1950s, an elite squad of detectives becomes embroiled in a conspiracy and faces a secret the U.S. government is determined to keep hidden.

programme.title: Hoodlum
programme.desc: In New York of the 1920s, three rival gang leaders (Laurence Fishhburne, Tim Roth and Andy Garcia) battle for control of Harlem's urban power.

programme.title: Fled
programme.desc: Two prison escapees on the lam race against time to find a hidden cache of cash and an incriminating computer disk.

programme.title: No Man's Land (1987)
programme.desc: When a rookie cop goes undercover at a Porsche garage doubling as a chop shop, the fast cars and wild parties have him thinking that his suspect has the life he wants. But there may be more going on than just car theft...and he may be in too deep!

programme.title: Navy Seals
programme.desc: Charlie Sheen, Michael Biehn and Bill Paxton are three of America's finest Navy commandos. Sent to rescue the crew of a U.S. aircraft carrying Stinger missiles seized by Mideast terrorists, they're thrust onto the frontline of an explosive conflict!

programme.title: The Terminator
programme.desc: It's a battle to ensure the future of all mankind from The Terminator in this modern classic!

programme.title: RoboCop
programme.desc: Classic sci-fi adventure about a cop...part man...part machine...the future of law enforcement.

programme.title: RoboCop 2
programme.desc: In this thrilling sequel, Robocop returns to fight his toughest opponent yet...his replacement!

programme.title: RoboCop 3
programme.desc: When a greedy corporation starts evicting families in favor of a very profitable real estate project, RoboCop (Robert John Burke) joins with a renegade band of freedom fighters to save them. But RoboCop must also face a new deadly android!

programme.title: Futureworld
programme.desc: After the "Westworld" disaster, the Delos corporation is back, this time with "Futureworld!" But the resort might not be as safe as Delos claims…

programme.title: Masters Of The Universe
programme.desc: The evil Skeletor (Frank Langella) is poised to conquer the universe. But fear not! He-Man (Dolph Lundgren) has declared war on Skeletor, and the battle between good and evil has come to Earth. Courtney Cox also stars in the epic, action-adventure.

programme.title: The Adventures Of Buckaroo Banzai Across The 8th Dimension
programme.desc: In this cult classic, neurosurgeon, physicist and rock star Buckaroo Banzai (Peter Weller) is ready to save the world when the evil Red Lectroids -- led by the deranged Lord John Whorfin (John Lithgow) -- are unleashed from the 8th dimension.

programme.title: Hackers
programme.desc: Boot up for suspense and high-powered excitement with Jonny Lee Miller and Angelina Jolie when a group of hackers, the rebels of the information age, find themselves embroiled in a plot that could destroy the world's ecosystems…or their own lives.

programme.title: The Mod Squad
programme.desc: Three problem teens headed to jail...until a police captain offers them a deal to work for him and go undercover in the hip L.A. club scene.

programme.title: Blown Away
programme.desc: When an explosion jolts Boston, bomb squad expert Jimmy Dove (Jeff Bridges) is thrust into the most harrowing work of his career. And when evidence points to his former mentor (Tommy Lee Jones), Dove must face a bitter enemy and a haunting past.

programme.title: To Live And Die In L.A.
programme.desc: Federal agent Richard Chance has a score to settle, and he's through playing by the rules. He vows to take down a murderous counterfeiter by any means necessary.

programme.title: Ronin
programme.desc: Robert De Niro, Jean Reno and Stellan Skarsgard headline a stellar cast in director John Frankenheimer's action-packed and intelligent spy thriller about a group of for-hire mercenaries out to steal a top-secret briefcase for a mysterious client.

programme.title: Death Warrant
programme.desc: Superstar Jean-Claude Van Damme is Louis Burke, an undercover detective who is investigating a series of murders at a penitentiary. But when he unearths a shocking secret, he must attempt a daring escape that pits him against an enemy from his past!

programme.title: Double Impact
programme.desc: Jean-Claude Van Damme leaps into dual roles of Chad and Alex Wagner, twin brothers separated after their parents’ brutal murder. Twenty-five years later, fate reunites them and ignites their determination to exact revenge... with two times the pain.

programme.title: Bloodsport
programme.desc: In the role that kicked his international career into high gear, Jean-Claude Van Damme stars as Frank Dux, a man who refuses to lose and who might just win himself a place in history as he competes in a full-contact world championship competition.

programme.title: The Octagon
programme.desc: Chuck Norris is back in this action-packed martial arts showcase co-starring the legendary Lee Van Cleef. Norris takes on his adoptive brother and a training camp where terrorists are being taught the secret killing techniques of the ninja!

programme.title: Enter The Ninja
programme.desc: When Cole (Franco Nero), a westerner trained in the deadly fighting rituals of Ninjitsu, is suddenly dragged into a dangerous dispute with an oil baron, he must face the best assassin money can buy, Ninja Hasegawa (martial arts legend Sho Kosugi)!

programme.title: Revenge Of The Ninja
programme.desc: When a band of Ninja assassins slaughters the family of Cho Osaki (Sho Kosugi), he flees to America in the hope of building a new life. Osaki tries to escape his deadly past but soon discovers he has become the pawn of a ruthless drug trafficker.

programme.title: Ninja III: The Domination
programme.desc: Possessed by the spirit of a diabolical Ninja assassin and dominated by his relentless rage, a young, attractive woman sets out to brutally attack and destroy his enemies. Can her boyfriend and a martial arts master possibly save her soul?

programme.title: Pray For Death
programme.desc: A vicious gang forces Akira to shed his quiet persona and reveal his other identity...that of a skilled Ninja!

programme.title: Rage Of Honor
programme.desc: When his partner is killed during a drug bust, a federal agent throws away his badge and the rule book with it. Arming himself with an array of deadly weaponry including nunchucks and ninja stars, he sets out to settle the score with the bad guys.

programme.title: American Ninja
programme.desc: Michael Dudikoff stars as Joe Armstrong, a one-man fighting machine. Serving in the army to avoid prison, Joe finds himself battling the deadly Black Star Order, as well as corrupt military leaders in order to bring down an illegal arms sale.

programme.title: American Ninja 2: The Confrontation
programme.desc: In this action-packed sequel, Joe Armstrong and Curtis Jackson are sent to the Caribbean in search of missing Marines. But they must first battle scientifically engineered Super Ninjas to bring down a dreaded drug lord known as The Lion!

programme.title: American Ninja 3: Blood Hunt
programme.desc: Martial artist David Bradley takes the reins as Sean Davidson in this third installment of the wildly popular "American Ninja" franchise, teaming up with Steve James to battle a maniacal terrorist in yet another explosive action-packed adventure!

programme.title: American Ninja 4: The Annihilation
programme.desc: Michael Dudikoff is back in action in this thrilling sequel! Teamed up with CIA operative Sean Davidson (David Bradley), Joe Armstrong (Dudikoff) returns to help foil the plans of a terrorist (James Booth) hell-bent on annihilating New York City.

programme.title: The Octagon
programme.desc: Chuck Norris is back in this action-packed martial arts showcase co-starring the legendary Lee Van Cleef. Norris takes on his adoptive brother and a training camp where terrorists are being taught the secret killing techniques of the ninja!

programme.title: Enter The Ninja
programme.desc: When Cole (Franco Nero), a westerner trained in the deadly fighting rituals of Ninjitsu, is suddenly dragged into a dangerous dispute with an oil baron, he must face the best assassin money can buy, Ninja Hasegawa (martial arts legend Sho Kosugi)!

programme.title: Doc
programme.desc: Stacy Keach, Haris Yulin and Faye Dunaway give riveting performances in this controversial and myth-shattering reexamination of the darker side of gunslinger Doc Holliday and the actions that led to the infamous showdown in Tombstone, Arizona.

programme.title: Lawman
programme.desc: In Michael Winner's unique take on the western, a sheriff (Burt Lancaster) is determined to bring to justice a rancher (Lee J. Cobb) and his hands who accidentally killed an old man during a drunken spree. Robert Ryan and Robert Duvall co-star.

programme.title: Valdez Is Coming
programme.desc: In this rousing Western, when a greedy rancher causes the death of an innocent man, former sheriff Bob Valdez (Burt Lancaster) orders him to provide financial support for the widow. But when he refuses, Valdez vows to exact justice at any cost!

programme.title: Invitation To A Gunfighter
programme.desc: Screen legend Yul Brynner turns in a magnificent performance as a gunfighter who must do battle with his most formidable adversary - his own conscience - in this gripping, double-barreled western full of surprise twists and colorful villainy.

programme.title: Return Of The Seven
programme.desc: Starring Yul Brynner and a stellar supporting cast that includes Robert Fuller, Warren Oates and Claude Akins, this classic western adventure follows the legendary Magnificent Seven as they thunder through Mexico to face the shootout of their lives!

programme.title: Guns Of The Magnificent Seven
programme.desc: In this thrilling follow-up to one of the greatest Western sagas in film history, notorious desperado Chris Adams (George Kennedy) is offered a huge reward to free a young Mexican revolutionary from prison…in the midst of the Mexican Revolution.

programme.title: The Magnificent Seven Ride!
programme.desc: When his wife is killed, Marshal Chris Adams (Lee Van Cleef) discovers that a ruthless horde of marauders have killed all the men -- and will come back for the women -- in a nearby border town...unless The Magnificent Seven can stop them!

programme.title: Day Of The Outlaw
programme.desc: In this stark, unconventional and powerful western, a ruthless rancher (Robert Ryan) must find a way to save the town of Bitters, Wyoming, its citizenry, and his own soul when a gang of outlaws rides into town. Burl Ives and Tina Louise also star.

programme.title: Gun The Man Down
programme.desc: When an outlaw is shot during a heist and left for dead by his partners - who take his money and his woman - he sets out to track them down. And when he catches up with them, he'll have to rely on his wits...as much as the loaded gun in his holster!

programme.title: Man From Del Rio
programme.desc: When a Mexican gunslinger (Anthony Quinn) rids a town of several notorious gunfighters, he is named the sheriff, but must win over the rest of the residents who are yet to warm to his hard-hitting ways. Katy Jurado and Peter Whitney co-star.

programme.title: Man With The Gun
programme.desc: As a gang of brutal gunmen forcefully gain control of Sheridan City, its terrified citizens hire the notorious "town-tamer" Clint Tollinger to help them. But Tollinger operates in his own way...so things could get a lot worse before they get better!

programme.title: The Wonderful Country
programme.desc: In this action-packed western, ex-pat Martin Brady (Robert Mitchum) travels to Texas to broker an arms deal for Mexican Governor Castro (Pedro Armendariz). But things get complicated when the the guns he was returning to Mexico are stolen.

programme.title: Young Billy Young
programme.desc: In this gun-slinging adventure, an aging lawman (Robert Mitchum) teams up with Young Billy Young (Robert Walker), a fast-draw outlaw on the run. But it's an alliance that explodes when the lawman discovers a secret that could rip two towns apart!

programme.title: Billy Two Hats
programme.desc: Archie (Gregory Peck) and his partner, Billy (Desi Arnaz, Jr.) are bandits by trade, staging daring robberies throughout the American frontier. But when their latest heist takes a deadly turn, they are pursued by a ruthless marshal (Jack Warden).

programme.title: The Spikes Gang
programme.desc: Lee Marvin gives a spellbinding performance as Harry Spikes, a wounded outlaw who appears as a romantic figure to three impressionable youths (Gary Grimes, Ron Howard and Charles Martin Smith) and who he enlists them as his bank-robbing partners.

programme.title: Buffalo Bill and the Indians, or Sitting Bull's History Lesson
programme.desc: Buffalo Bill has fought Indians & Civil War battles, but nothing can prepare him for show business! When he signs Sitting Bull for a role in his Wild West Show, the clash of cultures reverberates far beyond the boundaries of their sprawling theater.

programme.title: Cattle Annie And Little Britches
programme.desc: Burt Lancaster, Amanda Plummer and Diane Lane star in this offbeat western about two aspiring outlaws who join what’s left of the Doolin-Dalton gang.

programme.title: Comes A Horseman
programme.desc: Set in the American West of the 1940s, a pair of little-guy ranchers join forces against the depredations of a ruthless land baron determined to expand his empire at whatever cost. Starring Jane Fonda, James Caan, and Jason Robards.

programme.title: Rancho Deluxe
programme.desc: Jack (Jeff Bridges) and Cecil (Sam Waterston) are an oddball team of modern-day Montana cattle rustlers, and they've set their sights on a pair of unlikely ranch owners from New York (Clifton James, Elizabeth Ashley). But can they outfox the foxes?

programme.title: Robbers' Roost
programme.desc: Zane Grey Western of outlaw gangs fighting for control of ranchland.

programme.title: The Gunfight At Dodge City
programme.desc: Seeking a fresh start, Bat Masterson (Joel McCrea) rolls into Dodge City with a chip on his shoulder and a gun on his hip. But soon, his mysterious past will catch up with him when an old friend calls in a favor...one that might cost him his life!

programme.title: Five Guns West
programme.desc: Five Civil War outlaws must brave hostile Comanche territory – and a cunning woman – to hijack a stagecoach carrying a traitor...and $30,000 in gold!

programme.title: John Sturges' The Hallelujah Trail
programme.desc: Chaos reigns on the wide open plains as Burt Lancaster and Lee Remick let loose in this comedy that spoofs nearly every convention of movie westerns.

programme.title: Duel At Diablo
programme.desc: Frontier scout Jess Remsberg leads a wagon train through hostile territory to Fort Conchos. But underneath his valor, he has an ulterior motive: to settle a score with the man he believes killed his wife. James Garner and Sidney Poitier star.

programme.title: Hour Of The Gun
programme.desc: Director John Sturges presents a reworking of the Wyatt Earp/Doc Holliday legend and the struggle for political control of Tombstone, with a marvelous trio of antagonists: James Garner as Earp, Jason Robards as Holliday, and Robert Ryan as Clanton.

programme.title: Support Your Local Sheriff!
programme.desc: James Garner stars in this rollicking western spoof that has him taking on the job of a frontier town sheriff who must fend off villains (led by Walter Brennen) from every direction...all without breaking a sweat or dirtying his shiny black boots!

programme.title: Support Your Local Gunfighter
programme.desc: James Garner is back in the saddle again as hustler Latigo Smith whose latest con is passing off cowhand Jug (Jack Elam) as the dreaded gunman Swifty Morgan. But when the real Swifty shows up, the Wild West is going to get a whole lot wackier!

programme.title: ¡Three Amigos!
programme.desc: Steve Martin, Chevy Chase and Martin Short are three wild and crazy caballeros in this comedy adventure that’s a fiesta of fun.

programme.title: Man Of The East
programme.desc: East Meets West in this charming spaghetti western in which three petty crooks try to transform an East Coast dandy into a real Wild West man! Starring Terrence Hill, Gregory Walcott, Harry Carey Jr. and Dominic Barto and directed by Enzo Barboni!

programme.title: God Forgives, I Don't
programme.desc: A fast-shooting gunman and an insurance agent track down the murdering robbers of a train hijacking and the stolen money.

programme.title: Navajo Joe
programme.desc: Burt Reynolds, Aldo Sambrell and Fernando Rey star in this lusty, gutsy action western about a fearless Indian with a relentless vendetta against the band of outlaws that killed his people. Directed by Spaghetti Western legend Sergio Corbucci.

programme.title: Sam Whiskey
programme.desc: Welcome to America's Wild - and very wacky - West! Burt Reynolds, Clint Walker, Ossie Davis and Angie Dickinson star in this tongue-in-cheek tale of love, lust and larceny as an amiable con-artist is hire by a sexy widow to break into the U.S. Mint.

programme.title: The Scalphunters
programme.desc: Sydney Pollack directs Burt Lancaster, Shelley Winters, Ossie Davis and Telly Savalas in this lively and ribald western about a frontier-wise fur trapper who loses his pelts to a band of Kiowas in exchange for a slave he doesn't want.

programme.title: The Hills Run Red
programme.desc: A man recently released from a five-year prison sentence seeks vengeance against the former friend who has violated his trust and sought his death. Starring Thomas Hunter, Henry Silva, and Dan Duryea.

programme.title: Barquero
programme.desc: When a small town on the Paria River is decimated by a group of vile outlaws, the bandits get more than they bargained for after the local bargeman turns the tables on the vicious gang! Lee van Cleef and Warren Oates star in this rousing western.

programme.title: Sabata
programme.desc: Get ready for fast-paced, explosive action as Lee Van Cleef stars as Sabata, the mysterious, steely-eyed gunslinger who, after he discovers the masterminds behind an elaborate bank heist, imposes his bullet-laced brand of justice on a guilty town.

programme.title: Adios, Sabata
programme.desc: Under the brutal rule of garrison leader Col. Skimmel, a group of Mexican revolutionaries hire gunslinger Sabata (Yul Brynner) to rob a transport of gold in order to buy weapons. But the Colonel has other plans...taking the gold for himself.

programme.title: Return Of Sabata
programme.desc: The great Lee Van Cleef ("Death Rides a Horse") returns as the famous freewheeling gunslinger Sabata. In this third and final go-round for the enigmatic sharpshooter, Sabata seeks revenge when a band of desperadoes bilks him out of $5,000.

programme.title: Death Rides A Horse
programme.desc: Lee Van Cleef and John Phillip Law star in this bona fide Spaghetti Western classic as, fifteen years after bandits massacred his family, a young man seeking revenge forms an unlikely alliance with the outlaw who was framed for the murders.

programme.title: Top 5 Cold Cases: The Lie Detector
programme.desc: Jodie’s 15-year-old sister, Reesa, was brutally murdered on June 14, 1984. Jodie says she was only 13 years old and considered a prime suspect but the case went cold. It’s been over three decades, and she says the townspeople haven’t stopped gossiping and accusing her of murdering her only sibling. Will Jodie take Dr. Phil’s polygraph and end all the rumors? Then, Rachel accuses Walt of murdering her 14-year-old sister in 1985, despite his vehement denial. Walt agrees to take a polygraph test -- what will the results reveal? Next, When Sheena Morris was found hanged in a Florida hotel room on New Year's Day 2009, her death was ruled a suicide. But the 22-year-old's parents say they believe their daughter was murdered. On Dr. Phil's stage, they come face to face with the man they believe killed Sheena -- her 48-year-old fiancé, Joe. Joe takes a polygraph to prove his innocence. Then, Dr. Phil delves into the mystery of 15-year-old Erica Parsons, who was last seen nearly two years ago but was only recently reported missing. Casey and Sandy -- the adoptive parents -- are offered a chance to take a polygraph test. Finally, 17-year-old Josh Young says his father, Joshua Gouker, tried to frame him in the 2011 murder of his stepbrother, Trey Zwicker -- only to later confess to the murder himself. Gouker’s cousin, Cassi, says she was asked to dispose of a weapon and bloody clothes. Can Dr. Phil get to the truth?

programme.title: Top 5 Polygraph Reveals
programme.desc: Heather says her 19-year-old daughter, Nicki, has a history of lying and has faked two pregnancies and even fabricated a childbirth. Nicki admits that she lied about the first pregnancy but insists she really was pregnant the second time -- but had an abortion and was too scared to tell her mom. Nicki agrees to take a polygraph test -- what will the results reveal? Next, Barbie says her boyfriend, Travis, constantly accuses her of cheating and stealing money – which she denies. What proof does Travis say he has to support his claims? Barbie agrees to take a polygraph test to prove her innocence once and for all. Then, It’s been three years since Glenn Lemoine’s body was found floating in a canal, and his death remains a mystery. His family wants answers -- and they’re pointing the finger at each other. Two agree to take polygraph tests -- what will the results reveal? Next, Sarah says the last thing she remembers is taking her two young boys, ages 2 and 4, to the gas station, until she turned up at an area hospital miles away -- 13 hours later. Did she really lose her memory, or is she making the whole story up? Sarah undergoes a polygraph examination regarding her memory of what occurred during those 13 hours. Finally, Kelly says on August 2, 2011, he found his wife, Margaret, dead in the bathtub. Police ruled her death an accidental drowning -- but Margaret’s friends, Nancy and Christine, say they think she was murdered by her husband. Don’t miss his polygraph results!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: It’s Tuesday…And you can ask him ANYTHING! But don’t complain when Dr. Phil gives you the truth as he sees it. One 24-year-old turns to Dr. Phil because of something she just can’t let go of… her “Blankie.” She’s had it forever but now it’s affecting her marriage. Plus, tune-in to find out why Hollywood’s hottest celebrities are turning to Dr. Phil for “Get Real” solutions; and find out what Phil’s wife Robin thinks of him when he’s off stage.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: They lied, cheated, and fought like cats and dogs! Now, Dr. Phil brings back some of his most memorable guests. One cheating husband admits he had another affair just one week after the show. Will an emotional encounter with his daughters be the wakeup call he needs? And whatever happened to the dueling twin sisters that vowed to stop fighting—did they keep their promise? Plus, find out how one feuding couple salvaged their relationship after the show.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: What happens when spouses won’t pull their own weight as a parent? One wife complains that her husband always leaves their newborn with a sitter so he can have free time. What’s the reason behind his hands-off approach? Then, meet one new mom who’s ready to leave her husband because he refuses to help with their baby. Will this apathetic father change his ways? Also, Dr. Phil helps a stay-at-home mom control her destructive outbursts.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: If you think sexual predators are perverts who lurk in the bushes, on the Internet, or hang out at school yards, you couldn't be more wrong. What if they were a member of your family? What if you found out that your own child was molesting other children?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Could your child be the target of a bully? Young bullies and savage school bus beatings are on the rise. One mother moved so her son could be in a safer school; shortly thereafter, he was brutally attacked by seven boys on the school bus. Then, you won’t believe the shocking school bus footage of one young girl who kicked, stepped on, and beat another girl unconscious! You’ll be surprised why the bully thinks her behavior was justified. Plus, learn how you can protect your child from becoming the next victim.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: If you're a college student or the parent of one, you don't want to miss today's show. Robin McGraw shares her secrets for adjusting to an empty nest, and Dr. Phil has advice for making the most out of the college experience.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: A mother's suspicion, a dirty secret from the past and shocking allegations continue as Sherie-Lynn and her husband, Todd, confront the man they suspect has molested Sherie-Lynn's son, Parker. Did her father, Al, violate his own grandson? Catch up on what you missed in A Boy in Trouble.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil's guests say they have a home wrecker in their life who has destroyed their marriage. Lisa says her five-month marriage to Sean is already in a shambles because of his ex-wife, Kristy. Lisa says Kristy makes hateful phone calls, physical threats and frequent attempts to steal Sean away from her. Kristy says she doesn't want Sean back; she just wants him to be a good father to their kids. Then, Sherry says her daughter, Tammy, talked her into divorcing her husband, J.R. Now, Sherry wants to re-marry J.R., but both her daughters are making her choose between them or him. Tammy and her sister say that J.R. controls their mother and they won't support this reunion. Is Sherry making a big mistake, or are her daughters manipulating her? Dr. Phil weighs in on how much influence other people should have in your marriage and your life.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: If two people are truly in love, does anyone have the right to judge them? What if their relationship crosses moral boundaries? Dr. Phil's guests have been accused of causing turmoil and chaos in their families because of their unconventional relationships.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Four moms who are tired of leading a double life confessed why they live in fear, shame and guilt. See what happened. Now, three more women who have spent years hiding their secret reveal the truth to Dr. Phil.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Tired of leading a double life, these seven women confessed to Dr. Phil why they live in fear, shame and guilt. See what's happened. Now they go face-to-face with the men they've been deceiving.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: A new desperate housewife is ready to spill her secret to Dr. Phil. Plus, he checks in with the other women and the secrets they could no longer hide.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil tackles the emotionally-charged topic of DNA tests. Recently making news, Spice Girl Mel B. had a DNA test done to prove Eddie Murphy was the father of their baby. Dr. Phil conducts a paternity test for one of his guests and gives you the chance to be there when he reads the results " but don't expect any brawling theatrics on Dr. Phil's stage!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: It’s been three years since Glenn Lemoine’s body was found floating in a canal, and his death remains a mystery. His family wants answers -- and they’re pointing the finger at each other. Two agree to take polygraph tests -- what will the results reveal?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Mike and Vicki say their 37-year-old son, Ryan, was once making millions running a successful real estate company, but for the past three months, he has been living in their garage, on their dime, along with his 24-year-old girlfriend, Rachel. The parents claim Ryan is a “freeloader” who sleeps all day, acts entitled, picks fights and even leaves them to care for his 5-year-old son. Ryan admits things are chaotic in his life but insists it’s not all his fault. Why does he say his parents are partly to blame for his business failing? Dr. Phil has some tough questions for Ryan about his behavior -- does he take any accountability? And, hear from Rachel -- is she happy with their living situation? Plus, Ryan isn’t the only one staying with mom and dad -- you won’t believe how many mouths Mike and Vicki say they are feeding! How can the parents stop the bleeding and take back control of their lives? And, is Ryan ready to step up to the plate and work toward living on his own?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: If you or someone you know is pregnant, then you won’t want to miss today’s show! This episode is the first in a new series on pregnancy. Dr. Phil shares what they don’t tell you to expect when you’re expecting. Parents-to-be, Morgan and Shannon both have Type A personalities. She’s obsessed about her weight. He’s a neat freak. How can they prepare for an unpredictable lifestyle as parents? Then, tag along as they visit a daddy boot camp and a pregnancy gym. Plus, does carrying low mean you’re having a boy? An expert will help you sort out the truth from the myths when it comes to pregnancy.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: What happens when an unhealthy teen relationship threatens to tear a mother and daughter apart? Giesel says her 18-year-old daughter, Devynn, is obsessed with her boyfriend and is damaging a once promising future. Watch the drama unfold as a pregnancy scare rocks this teen's life.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: These moms are sick and tired of living a lie. One mom fears her secret addiction to pain killers will tear her family apart. She asks Dr. Phil to help her get off the drugs before she loses everything, including her unborn child! Also, a grandmother who steals everything from steaks to ceiling fans. She says she knows it’s wrong and wants to stop, but is she really just afraid of getting caught? Plus, a mother confesses to her daughter a secret she has been carrying for 29 years.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Two families desperate to find their missing children ask Dr. Phil for help. Two-year-old Bianca disappeared while in the care of her father. He says she was taken when he was carjacked. Was he involved in her disappearance? And, Josh hasn’t seen his son, Trenton, since he was 2 years old, more than five years ago. Did the boy's mother, who died by suicide, take clues with her to the grave?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: “He loves me. He loves me not.” Wouldn’t it be great if there was a formula to get your partner to commit? Josie has been dating Curry for more than three years, and she says she’s ready to dump him if he doesn’t pop the question soon. Curry says he loves his girlfriend, so why is he afraid to walk down the aisle? Will Josie hold out for a ring, or will she kick this commitment-phobe to the curb? Then, Melissa thought she had it all –- the ring, the dress and the man of her dreams –- until she discovered her wedding was a sham. She says her husband, John, lied about how many times he’d been married, but the biggest tale of all is that he’s still married to another woman! John admits that he lied about being divorced, but says Melissa wouldn’t have stayed with him if he told her the truth. Will Melissa ever be able to trust him again ... and should she? Plus, meet a couple who says their dream wedding turned into a nightmare when the wedding planner scammed them out of $30,000.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: The 1957 kidnapping and murder of Maria Ridulph went cold for 55 years, until Jack McCullough, once known as John Tessier, was arrested and eventually convicted -- despite maintaining his innocence. Dr. Phil speaks to family members on both sides. Could McCullough have been wrongfully convicted?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Imagine your mother so high on prescription drugs that she falls face first into her food, or your husband on a 15-day drug binge that ends with him passing out in front of your young children. For Dr. Phil's guests, these scenarios are their grim reality.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Do you worry your teen daughter could throw away everything she's worked for - all for young love? Dina says she gave her daughter, Sammie, everything she'd ever wanted, but the 19-year-old is now only interested in one thing: her 20-year-old boyfriend, Chris, who has a criminal record. Despite cutting the teen off financially, Dina says her ultimatums fell flat and fears they may only have pushed Sammie further into the arms of a boyfriend she thinks is bad news and may be dangerous. Sammie says her controlling mother and sheltered upbringing are the real problems - but, can she explain the bruises on her body? Then, Samantha is a teen who was blinded by her love affair with her allegedly abusive boyfriend, Aaron. Don't miss her update and somber words for Sammie, whom she fears may be walking blindly down the perilous path she says she knows too well.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Ask any teenager, and he or she will tell you how tough life is: schoolwork, dating and dealing with pushy parents. But imagine having two kids while you're still in high school. Dr. Phil sits down with Corey and Kim, a troubled young couple, to see if their relationship can be saved.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: 80% of all communication is non-verbal, and, as the old saying goes, you never get a second chance to make a first impression. In this episode, Dr. Phil focuses on body language and appearance rather than the words we speak. Learn from one couple how the little things we do can mean more than saying “I love you.” Plus, is she simply a self-confident woman, or are her actions driving men away?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: In 1985, Rachel’s 14-year-old sister, Lori, was found murdered, and Rachel is desperate to prove her claim that Lori’s ex-boyfriend, Walt, killed the teen and got away with it -- an accusation he vehemently denies. Walt was initially tried for the murder, but the case was dismissed after the trial resulted in a hung jury -- and he says Rachel needs to stop pointing the finger at him and move on. Tensions run high when Rachel confronts Walt on Dr. Phil’s stage. Where was Walt the night of Lori’s death? And, how does he explain allegations that he has made inconsistent statements to police? Then, Walt says he passed a polygraph in 1985, clearing his name. Dr. Phil calls on polygraph expert Jack Trimarco to examine the results -- what are his thoughts? Plus, don’t miss Part 2, when Walt takes a new polygraph test -- what will the results reveal?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Do you have a man in your life who stomps his feet, pouts, whines and acts like a toddler? A bride-to-be is dealing with an immature fiance and a meddling mother-in-law, and a mooching groom is living in his mom's basement with his common-law wife and baby. Today's guests are grown men whose loved ones want them to grow up!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dennis Quaid joins Dr. Phil to discuss his new movie, “Yours, Mine and Ours". In this family comedy, single parents Frank (Dennis Quaid) and Helen (Rene Russo) plan to tie the knot… but with 18 children between them trying to sabotage the marriage, they discover that weddings – and families – can’t be built in a day. Then, meet a real-life blended family whose battles are tearing them apart. Arguments over space, chores, and discipline make it feel like a war zone for two families trying to blend under one roof. Dr. Phil gives advice to this Brady Bunch gone wild!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil digs further into the heartbreaking story of a father's desperate search for his missing daughter, Kimberly Medina, and the loss he felt when his grandchildren were taken away by the man who may be guilty of their mother's disappearance. It's a shocking story that has had a ripple effect on three generations. Don't miss this chilling tale that will have you hugging your loved ones a little tighter.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: This is a true crime saga like no other. The Murdaugh family is one of the most prominent families in South Carolina and has served in powerful legal positions dating back nearly 100 years. Rumors swirled that Alex Murdaugh and his family could get away with anything. They have been tied to the mysterious deaths of their housekeeper, a high school classmate, and a young woman in a fatal boat crash. In June 2021, Murdaugh allegedly found his wife and younger son shot dead on their hunting lodge property. About a year later, Murdaugh was charged for their murders. The killings set off a bizarre chain of events that included Murdaugh staging his own murder. There are also nearly 100 financial crimes that are linked to him. Dr. Phil is joined by a panel of experts: former criminal prosecutor Loni Coombs; Michal Higdon, anchor and investigative reporter at WCSC-TV Charleston; forensic expert Joseph Scott Morgan; and former FBI agent Bobby Chacon to discuss this case.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Tiffany, 23, shocked her parents when she admitted that she was hooked on heroin. After successfully completing a treatment program, and 166 days into her recovery, she relapsed. Find out who she blames for her addiction problems!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: At 22, Jael was an aspiring model and finalist on the hit show America’s Next Top Model. But at 28, Jael’s family says she’s losing her battle with drug addiction. Don’t miss what happens minutes before she’s to appear on Dr. Phil’s stage. Can Dr. Phil convince her to stop running and commit to getting well?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: On March 2, 2012, 19-year-old Jacob “Jake” Limberios was fatally shot in the head in the presence of three friends. The coroner ruled his death a suicide -- but Jake’s parents, Mike and Shannon, say it doesn’t add up. They claim there was no investigation into Jake’s death, no evidence collected and no autopsy performed before Jake's death was ruled a suicide -- and they refuse to believe their son would take his own life. Jake’s family say a lot of questions remain unanswered, including: Who fired the shot? Two witnesses, Brittany and Will, adamantly maintain that Jake accidentally shot himself, but Mike and Shannon say their son knew how to handle guns safely and that the evidence doesn’t support that conclusion. Mike takes Dr. Phil cameras to the scene of the shooting to demonstrate why he believes that Jake was shot by someone else in the room. And, Brittany and Will face Mike and Shannon on Dr. Phil’s stage in an attempt to clear the cloud of suspicion that they say still follows them as a result of Mike and Shannon’s allegations. When offered a chance to take a polygraph test, will they accept? Don’t miss this compelling two-part mystery.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Good fences make good neighbors, but Dr. Phil's guests say no matter how high the fence, they can't seem to end their vicious feud.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Ask any teenager, and he or she will tell you how tough life is: schoolwork, dating and dealing with pushy parents. But imagine having two kids while you're still in high school. Dr. Phil sits down with Corey and Kim, a troubled young couple, to see if their relationship can be saved.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Do you ever feel that dealing with your spouse is like having another child? Dr. Phil talks to today’s guests about growing up. We’ll meet a mother of four who feels like her husband is a fifth child and not a good role model. Another guest is afraid to start a family with her husband because of his addiction to video games. Plus, will Dr. Phil convince a wife and mother to let go of her obsession with her high school glory days and live in the present?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Can a mistress save a marriage? Chrissy fears that she’ll have to embrace this drastic option to salvage her relationship. Her husband, Scott, has been having an affair with Tracy for five years, and he wants Chrissy to consider negotiated infidelity, an arrangement where partners are given permission to stray. He even suggested that his mistress buy the house next door to theirs! Chrissy says Scott is a loving dad to their three kids, and she wonders if there’s hope for their 10-year marriage. Find out what happens when she faces off with the other woman onstage. Will Chrissy agree to an open marriage, or will she cut her losses and move on?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Morgan and Ashley claim their mom, Treva, is “a toxic, violent alcoholic,” who they say is way out of control, and that although she’s been to rehab eight times, she’s never stayed sober. In the past year, Morgan says the police have been called to the house 57 times for violence, threats, assault and even arson. Morgan says if her mom doesn’t stop her excessive drinking and end the violence, she will walk away for good. Treva says she does not want to go to another “dumb treatment center” as she is “done with them” and claims they do not work for her. Treva has said that she believes the problem is 10% her and 90% everyone else – and that she believes her family needs an intervention.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: They borrow money and don't pay you back. They're unemployed and never pay rent. If you're tired of a loved one's freeloading ways, Dr. Phil has advice for getting the handouts to stop. Ryan, 29, says he's living the life of "a starving artist," but his sisters say he's just a moocher. He even tries to mooch off Dr. Phil! Then, Jennell says her husband has turned her into a moocher by forcing her to ask her own mother to pay their bills. Will he give up his dreams of playing poker professionally or keep gambling by living off their savings and watching his marriage slip away?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Despite having 3,000 bottles of shampoo, 30,000 shirts, 5,000 cookbooks, and boxes on top of boxes of things, Kristen says she doesn’t think she is a hoarder. But Kristen claims her “collection of things” has created a problem. She just bought a new house and after already moving in 600 boxes, she says she's completely running out of room, and there is a whole lot more to pack. From buying unclaimed storage containers to dumpster diving, Kristen says she cannot give up an opportunity to collect something that’s a good deal. But is there more to Kristen’s collecting than meets the eye? Find out the shocking reason Kristen says it is hard for her to part with her belongings. Plus, meet Kristen’s friends who say they are concerned that her “hoarding” is keeping their friend isolated.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil talks to controlling, combative, outspoken guests whose loved ones want them off their back! First up, Tia demands perfection from her kids in school, music and sports. She's even picked out the perfect bride for her 14-year-old son! Then, he’s been called “the worst husband in Dr. Phil history!” When Deanna and Mike last appeared on Dr. Phil, Mike shocked the nation when he told his wife to “shut her suck hole!” He even tells her how to brush her teeth and take showers. Now they are back! Find out how their relationship has changed, and what will happen if Mike’s old habits re-appear!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: It's a story that captured the nation: Warren Jeffs, the leader of the Fundamentalist Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-Day Saints (FLDS) and self-proclaimed prophet, was one of the FBI's 10 Most Wanted Fugitives for unlawful flight, sexual conduct with a minor and conspiracy to conduct sexual conduct with a minor. Captured in 2006, Jeffs was recently convicted of sexually assaulting children and sentenced to life, plus 20 years in prison. With an estimated 10,000 followers in his polygamous sect, what will become of Warren Jeffs' victims?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Making New Year’s resolutions is easy; the hard part is keeping them. Over 90 percent of people give up before ever reaching their goal. Dr. Phil says there's no better time than now to make a change in your life and start creating what you want instead of settling for what you don’t. Learn his five powerful secrets to success in making your resolutions a reality. He shares the stories of three couples with three very different problems they resolve to fix in the New Year. Allyson and James resolve to improve their financial picture, get out of debt and stop living hand-to-mouth. Next, Missy is making one of the most popular resolutions: to lose weight in the New Year. Will she meet her goal in time for her wedding to Justin? Then, Jill and Matt are busy parents whose sex life has gone from fireworks to fizzled out. Their resolution is to reignite the flames and have more sex. Plus, Jim Cramer, author and host of CNBC’s Mad Money, offers a solid strategy for achieving financial resolutions in 2009. This is practical advice you won’t want to miss, whether your income is meager or in the millions. Don’t just make resolutions this year. Tune in to learn how to keep them!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Imagine finding your son passed out in his room with drug paraphernalia surrounding his body. When that happened to one mother, she made an important call for help. Dr. Phil’s son, Jay, was working with a family for his new reality show when the mom, Vikki, phoned to say that her son, Justin, had been using drugs. Dr. Phil made a surprise house call and insisted that the teen get help immediately. Find out what happens with Justin, and why Vikki thinks she's to blame for his drug use. Then, a stay-at-home mother of three was drinking bottles of wine and vodka every day -- she would even fill a sports drink bottle with alcohol and take it to her kids' school events. Did she break her deadly addiction?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Many women are itching to run to the altar, but Dr. Phil’s guests say they’re ready to run for the hills! Kelly is a self-proclaimed runaway bride. She’s been engaged four times but says she gets cold feet before she makes it down the aisle. Rick, her current fiancé, proposed four years ago and is still waiting for her to set a wedding date. Kelly believes that most marriages end in divorce, and she doesn’t want to become another statistic. Should Rick wait for her to make up her mind, or should he cut his losses and move on? Then, Chad and Candi have been engaged for over five years and have two daughters, but Chad says he’s not ready to tie the knot. He says weddings are too expensive, but Candi says he racked up $49,000 in loans for a car, a camper and a new deck for the house. Will Chad break down and give his fiancée the wedding of her dreams? Plus, Dr. Phil talks to a woman who says her fiancé left her six days before the wedding and stuck her with a $150,000 bill -- an allegation he totally denies.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Courtney claims that after her parents’ divorce six years ago, her mother, Michelle, became a “party girl” who basically traded in her children for a life of parties, drinking and men. Courtney says her mother’s dangerous behavior has already resulted in 2 DUIs and a serious car accident that nearly killed her. Courtney says her greatest fear is that “the next time I see my mom will be at her funeral.” Michelle claims that after her divorce, Courtney and her two other children went on with their lives without her, and says that’s why she turned to friends, men and drinking. What does Dr. Phil say Michelle must do to save her life and save her relationship with her children?

programme.title: Dr.Phil
programme.desc: One of the most asked-about guests, Brandon, returns with an update.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil is fed up with teens being terrorized -- both in the schoolyard and online -- and he’s putting bullies on notice! This summer, he took the battle against cyber bullies before Congress, and now he’s kicking off his own Anti-Bully Movement. Learn how cyber bullying is affecting 12-year-old Dara, and why her mom, Toni, fears the tween may harm herself if she doesn’t get help. Then, hear why Michael, a self-proclaimed cyber bully, defends his keyboard antics. Plus, Congresswoman Carolyn McCarthy weighs in on bullying and cyber bullying and what can be done about this growing epidemic, and Parry Aftab, executive director and founder of StopCyberBullying.org, shares tips to keep your kids safe. Join the movement, and take Dr. Phil’s pledge to fight the abuse!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil tackles one of the most dangerous trends affecting young adults today -- cyberbullying. Kalista, 20, claims she has been virtually assaulted for almost two years by Taylor, 20, a girl who Kalista says loves to attack people when they’re at their lowest point. Kalista says Taylor has posted photos of her online and written lies that she does drugs, is a stripper and a prostitute. Kalista says she’s not the only victim of Taylor’s alleged bullying -- Shelby, 22, and Shayna, 21, say they also have been targeted -- and she’s worried someone may be pushed too far. How do they say Taylor’s alleged actions have affected them? Taylor admits she has made nasty comments -- why does she say she was only defending herself? Dr. Phil brings all parties together to try to end the hostility. Are these young women ready to unplug and end the animosity? Plus, hear from the mother of a 12-year-old girl who tragically ended her own life after being cyberbullied. Will her story make an impact?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: The conversation continues with a woman who claims she is "Mother God."

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil looks into the nature of passive aggressive and pessimistic behaviors. One wife needs Dr. Phil’s help dealing with her passive aggressive husband. He never tells her what he’s thinking and often leaves to avoid confrontation. She says this punishment is hurtful and has their marriage in serious jeopardy. Plus, meet a college student whose negativity is alienating her from friends and potential boyfriends. Tune in for Dr. Phil’s cure for this bad case of bad attitude.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Every 10 seconds an animal is abused in this country. By the time this show is over, nearly 240 animals will be tortured. Dr. Phil, a huge animal lover, is taking a stand. First up, Rob says dog fighting is not a crime, and believes that it’s no different than boxing or football. He was convicted of a felony after authorities caught him in the act and says he wants to clear up the misconception about dog fighting. Is this “sport” in Rob’s DNA, or can he be rehabilitated? Will Rob get a wake-up call about his reckless ways? Then, they may look like a group of tattooed tough guys, but cast members from the TV show Rescue Ink say they’re on a mission to save animals in danger. Take a look as they go inside a dog fighting yard to demonstrate how they gather evidence for a bust. Plus, New Yorkers were outraged by surveillance video that captured Chris Grant terrorizing his girlfriend’s Pomeranian on an elevator. Learn how Chris’ father reacts to his behavior. Viewer discretion is advised.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: What creates a monster? As the popular new Netflix series Dahmer - Monster: The Jeffrey Dahmer Story pushes the heinous crimes of the notorious serial killer back into the spotlight, what can we learn about what may have made him the evil he was? Do chilling home videos of Jeffrey Dahmer as a little boy show an innocent child before he became evil? Or, were the signs already there? His parents reveal the red flags they say they missed.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: The new series Dahmer - Monster: The Jeffrey Dahmer Story may have landed the number one spot on Netflix, but it wasn’t popular with everyone. Angry family members of Dahmer’s victims say the controversial drama re-traumatized them and romanticized the notorious serial killer. You’ve seen Hollywood’s version. Today, Dr. Phil is telling the real story and meeting the real people who say they knew the real monster that was Jeffrey Dahmer. In an exclusive interview, hear from the sister of one victim who says the series glorified the man she calls “Satan,” as well as two men who say they were tortured and terrorized by Dahmer and survived.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Victims and survivors of Jeffrey Dahmer say they want people to see him for who he really was -- not the glamorized TV version. See a never-before-aired interview with Dahmer’s father and stepmother that sheds light on the monster behind the man. They provide chilling details about his bizarre childhood behaviors. Plus, the Netflix series Dahmer - Monster: The Jeffrey Dahmer Story pushed a decades-old story into today’s spotlight, some say giving it a 2022 “pop culture moment.” After the series debuted, Dahmer’s infamous glasses went up for sale for $150,000, and people dressed up as the notorious serial killer for Halloween. Has our culture’s obsession with true crime desensitized us?
